name: The Ship's Wire
persona: Extreme economy of words. Clipped fragments, near stage directions. Nouns and verbs, few articles. Cold, fast, spare. Ship: 'we', used sparingly. Island: a curt clerk, 'we'.

ship.founder: Log opened. {name}{rankc}. A {home} {type}. Mine now. Kept plain.
ship.successor: New hand on the book. {name}{rankc}. Entries carried on. No frills.
ship.mutiny: Master over the side. Crew hands me the book. {name}. Green. Learning her fast.
ship.rogue: Colours down. Black flag up. {name}{rankc}. All taken now. None traded.
ship.prize: She struck. Boarded. Taken. {name}{rankc}. Her book, my hand.
ship.recovered: Hunter ran the rogues down. Hull freed. {name}{rankc}. Bound home. Honest trade again.

island.founder: {place} taken up. {name}{rankc}. Ledger opened. Kept short.
island.overthrow: Old ruler down. Seal seized. {name}{rankc}. {place} mine.

ship.pirate: Still out. Flag up. Still taking{bounty}.
ship.default: Still afloat. Still working her. Out of {home}.

island.haven: Black flag up. No law. No ledger. Book shut.
island.default: {place} holds. {population} souls. That is the account.

quiet.ship: Little to log. Fair winds. Full holds. Quiet water.
quiet.island: Quiet books. Trade in. Trade out. No blood. Good.

say: {we} ran {foe} down — {goods} bales, {gold}g, let her limp
{we} boarded {foe} — took {goods} crates, {gold}g, cut her loose
{foe} struck quick — {goods} casks and {gold}g out of her hold
{we} stripped {foe} clean — {goods} chests, {gold}g, sent her off
{we} took {foe} — {goods} bales, {gold}g, no blood spilt
{foe} yielded fast — {we} lifted {goods} crates and {gold}g, left the hulk
{we} hit {foe} at dawn — {goods} casks, {gold}g, gone by noon
{we} holed {foe} — she filled, went down, cargo with her
{foe} took our broadside — under in minutes, nothing saved
{we} sank {foe} cold — no boarding, no loot, just the deep
{foe} rolled, sank — {we} watched her go bows-first
{we} put {foe} on the bottom — mast last to show
{foe} would not strike — {we} sent her under whole
{we} gutted {foe} at the waterline — down she went, all of her
{we} ran {foe} down — black flag under, one less on the lanes
{foe} ran — {we} caught her, sank her, done
{we} cornered {foe} — no quarter, straight to the bottom
{foe} raided these waters — {we} ended it, ended her
{we} chased {foe} two days — took her on the third, sank her
{foe} showed the black rag — {we} put her under it
{we} hunted {foe} to ground — cut her down, lanes clear
{foe} came for us — {we} shot her under, held the hold
{we} stood {foe} off — raked her, sank her, kept our own
{foe} thought us soft — {we} put her down instead
{we} took {foe}'s charge — turned it, sent her deep
{foe} closed to board — {we} broke her, drowned her
{we} met {foe} gun for gun — she sank first
{foe} ran alongside — {we} holed her, watched her go under
